speak: Every year, the African diaspora sends hundreds of billions of dollars home. A transfer moves the money, but it does not control what the money is used for.
caption: Every year, the African diaspora sends hundreds of billions of dollars home. A transfer moves the money, but it does not control what the money is used for.

speak: Nob Pay fixes that. The money stays in escrow, and it is released step by step, only when the work is shown.
caption: NobPay fixes that. The money stays in escrow, and it is released step by step, only when the work is shown.

speak: In this tour, we create one project for each of the five business models the app supports, and follow each one to its last paid step.
caption: In this tour, we create one project for each of the five business models the app supports, and follow each one to its last paid step.

speak: This is the live demo. Payments are simulated, so nothing here moves real money. We sign in with the demo account.
caption: This is the live demo. Payments are simulated, so nothing here moves real money. We sign in with the demo account.

speak: This is the funder's dashboard. We start a new project.
caption: This is the funder's dashboard. We start a new project.

speak: First model: real estate. Build, renovate, or buy land. We pick the model, name the project, and set a budget.
caption: First model: real estate. Build, renovate, or buy land. We pick the model, name the project, and set a budget.

speak: The app proposes the steps for this model, from checking the land title to the finishing work. Each step says which proof it needs, and everything can be edited.
caption: The app proposes the steps for this model, from checking the land title to the finishing work. Each step says which proof it needs, and everything can be edited.

speak: Then we name the person on site, who will send the proofs and never touches the money.
caption: Then we name the person on site, who will send the proofs and never touches the money.

speak: The project exists. Relatives abroad can already join in: a family link lets anyone add to the escrow from any Lightning wallet, with no account. A first name, if given, appears in the public record.
caption: The project exists. Relatives abroad can already join in: a family link lets anyone add to the escrow from any Lightning wallet, with no account. A first name, if given, appears in the public record.

speak: The funder adds the rest through a Lightning invoice. In this demo it cannot be paid, so we simulate the payment, and the escrow is credited.
caption: The funder adds the rest through a Lightning invoice. In this demo it cannot be paid, so we simulate the payment, and the escrow is credited.

speak: The funder also names an independent witness, here a neighbour, who looks at each proof from outside.
caption: The funder also names an independent witness, here a neighbour, who looks at each proof from outside.

speak: The first step asks for the land title. The person on site opens a private link, with no account, photographs the document, and says who should be paid.
caption: The first step asks for the land title. The person on site opens a private link, with no account, photographs the document, and says who should be paid.

speak: The witness sees the proof and confirms. The answer goes to the funder, and into the public record under the witness's name.
caption: The witness sees the proof and confirms. The answer goes to the funder, and into the public record under the witness's name.

speak: The funder sees the proof, the witness's answer, and the checks the app ran: is this file already used somewhere else, was the phone in Senegal. The checks help, they never decide.
caption: The funder sees the proof, the witness's answer, and the checks the app ran: is this file already used somewhere else, was the phone in Senegal. The checks help, they never decide.

speak: Before paying, the quote shows what is debited, the rate, and what the supplier receives. She confirms, and the supplier is paid directly.
caption: Before paying, the quote shows what is debited, the rate, and what the supplier receives. She confirms, and the supplier is paid directly.

speak: The same loop repeats for every step. Here is the project, with all six steps paid.
caption: The same loop repeats for every step. Here is the project, with all six steps paid.

speak: Second model: farming. The steps follow the season: soil, sowing, inputs, harvest, and the sale of the harvest.
caption: Second model: farming. The steps follow the season: soil, sowing, inputs, harvest, and the sale of the harvest.

speak: Each work step asks for photos and an invoice. Selling the harvest asks only for the invoice.
caption: Each work step asks for photos and an invoice. Selling the harvest asks only for the invoice.

speak: For the work steps, the proof is photos and the supplier's invoice. The photos carry the phone's date and position.
caption: For the work steps, the proof is photos and the supplier's invoice. The photos carry the phone's date and position.

speak: The funder checks, approves, and the supplier is paid.
caption: The funder checks, approves, and the supplier is paid.

speak: Season over: every step is paid, and the project is complete.
caption: Season over: every step is paid, and the project is complete.

speak: Third model: a shop. Initial stock, delivery, shelving, then restocking.
caption: Third model: a shop. Initial stock, delivery, shelving, then restocking.

speak: Buying stock and restocking need an invoice, delivery needs photos and an invoice, and shelving needs photos.
caption: Buying stock and restocking need an invoice, delivery needs photos and an invoice, and shelving needs photos.

speak: Some steps need only an invoice. Buying the first stock is proven by the supplier's bill.
caption: Some steps need only an invoice. Buying the first stock is proven by the supplier's bill.

speak: The funder approves, and the supplier is paid.
caption: The funder approves, and the supplier is paid.

speak: Four steps, four payments, and the shop is stocked.
caption: Four steps, four payments, and the shop is stocked.

speak: Fourth model: school fees, paid straight to the school. Registration, supplies, then one payment per term.
caption: Fourth model: school fees, paid straight to the school. Registration, supplies, then one payment per term.

speak: Every step asks for the school's invoice, and the supplies add photos.
caption: Every step asks for the school's invoice, and the supplies add photos.

speak: The school's receipt is the proof. The money goes to the school, never through a middleman.
caption: The school's receipt is the proof. The money goes to the school, never through a middleman.

speak: The school is paid directly, once the funder approves.
caption: The school is paid directly, once the funder approves.

speak: Each payment comes with a receipt that the funder can keep and share.
caption: Each payment comes with a receipt that the funder can keep and share.

speak: All five payments are made, and the school year is covered.
caption: All five payments are made, and the school year is covered.

speak: Fifth model: restocking from a wholesaler. Order confirmed, goods delivered, goods on the shelf.
caption: Fifth model: restocking from a wholesaler. Order confirmed, goods delivered, goods on the shelf.

speak: The order needs an invoice, the delivery needs photos and an invoice, and the shelving needs photos.
caption: The order needs an invoice, the delivery needs photos and an invoice, and the shelving needs photos.

speak: Delivery is proven with photos and the wholesaler's invoice. The payment follows the goods, not the promise.
caption: Delivery is proven with photos and the wholesaler's invoice. The payment follows the goods, not the promise.

speak: The wholesaler is paid once the delivery is shown.
caption: The wholesaler is paid once the delivery is shown.

speak: Three steps, and the shelves are full.
caption: Three steps, and the shelves are full.

speak: Every event, in every project, joins a hash chained ledger. Change one line, and everything after it breaks.
caption: Every event, in every project, joins a hash-chained ledger. Change one line, and everything after it breaks.

speak: We anchor its fingerprint on Bitcoin, with Open Timestamps. Only the fingerprint leaves the app.
caption: We anchor its fingerprint on Bitcoin, with OpenTimestamps. Only the fingerprint leaves the app.

speak: A public page lets anyone check the file, without an account. The browser redoes the calculations itself.
caption: A public page lets anyone check the file, without an account. The browser redoes the calculations itself.

speak: The public record shows steps and amounts. Photo positions and notes stay private: only sealed fingerprints are published. So nobody has to trust our server.
caption: The public record shows steps and amounts. Photo positions and notes stay private: only sealed fingerprints are published. So nobody has to trust our server.

speak: What is real: the ledger, the Bitcoin anchoring, and the verification. The Lightning path is tested against a wallet simulator, not yet with real sats, and Nostr publishing is off on this free demo.
caption: What is real: the ledger, the Bitcoin anchoring, and the verification. The Lightning path is tested against a wallet simulator, not yet with real sats, and Nostr publishing is off on this free demo.

speak: Nob Pay: pay on proof. Five business models, one engine. Try it at nob pay dot on render dot com. The code is open source on GitHub.
caption: NobPay: pay on proof. Five business models, one engine. Try it at nobpay.onrender.com. The code is open source on GitHub.
